pages.title: Skateshop
pages.text: Between races in Skitchin', you spend your prize money on new gear at the skate shop, and Skateshop is the music that plays there. Every skater starts the tour with $100.

pages.title: The shopkeeper
pages.text: The skate shop owner won't sell you anything that would leave you short of the next entry fee. "Nice try bud! Check your wallet!" he says. If you buy wheels while your skates are worn out, he tells you your priorities are a bit off.

pages.title: What the game cost
pages.text: In 1994, a Skitchin' cartridge cost $59.95 in the US and 44.99 pounds in the UK.
